correctness.rationale: The initial zeros are fixed in stable rank; after the first nonzero, every zero at index i maps to i minus the positive number of earlier nonzeros. Thus every other cycle uses at least one nonzero and the deterministic sandwich holds, including the all-zero word. The initial run has tail (1−ε)^j for 0≤j≤n. For ε>0 it couples to the floor of an exponential of rate −log(1−ε), capped at n; capping and rounding cost at most 1/n after rescaling. The pathwise difference from K/n costs at most E[R]/n=ε. On [0,1] the Wasserstein distance between capped exponentials is the integral of the absolute survival-function difference; |exp(−at)−exp(−bt)|≤t|a−b| gives the exact factor 1/2, also at rate zero. For nε bounded, −n log(1−ε)=nε+O(nε²). For nε→∞ and ε→0, the initial run is o_P(n) and E[R]/n→0. In the finer regime its ε-scaled truncated geometric law tends to Exp(1) because nε→∞, and E[εR]=nε²→0. If ε=0 the word gives K=n exactly. The finite checker was inspected, not executed.

evidence: D_i counts fixed points associated to label i and has law min(Geo_0(1−p_i),n). For the least i, its ranks count only copies of that symbol up to the current index, so D_0 is exactly the initial run. Proposition 3.11 excludes monochromatic cycles of length greater than one since their label words are not primitive.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Consequently K−D_0 counts only disjoint cycles each containing a rare position, so 0≤K−D_0≤R deterministically. This is the first-defect sandwich itself. Round a capped exponential of rate −n log(1−ε) on the normalized grid, take expected cost ε for the other cycles, and integrate t|α−λ| for the rate change: this yields the stated W1 bound. The critical and finer windows then come directly from that same geometric law and E[R]=nε, without new distributional analysis.

originality.rationale: The claimed first-defect mechanism and its law are covered by the combination of two directly relevant existing results in Guerder, not merely by the availability of a general exact generating function. Proposition 3.1 identifies the fixed-point count of the least symbol with the exact truncated-geometric law, and Proposition 3.11 identifies all longer cycle labels as primitive, making the deterministic error bound immediate. The explicit near-deterministic theorem is not printed there; the stated error and scales follow by elementary capped-geometric coupling and rescaling of these results.
residual_risks: No claim is made that Guerder prints the exact triangular-array statement, or about the earliest independent derivation. The original 1995 full text was not accessible; the scientific coverage determination rests on the inspected Guerder propositions and explicit inference.

value.rationale: As a mathematical description, the singular regime is worth understanding: it gives a macroscopic non-Gaussian fluctuation with an endpoint atom, and gives a uniform estimate independent of the rare alphabet, across more than one scaling.
